personal.title: The Psychology of Love [Redefined]
personal.excerpt: What is love? A breakdown of trust, care, and support — and why natural love hits different from planned love.

personal.title: Desires: The Endless Cycle of Life
personal.excerpt: Desire rarely disappears — it changes its subject. A reflection on the endless cycle of wanting, adaptation, and what happens when we finally ask why.

personal.title: What Success Means to Me and Why
personal.excerpt: Success isn't a number in a bank account. For me, it's becoming capable enough to build a life, financially independent enough to protect it, and present enough to actually live it.

personal.title: What I've Achieved in My Life and How
personal.excerpt: Emotional control, self-awareness, and frameworks like CDMA, PSI, and a gamified learning system — most of them started as accidents, frustration, and curiosity, not plans.

personal.title: Do Men Have a Harder Life Than Women?
personal.excerpt: Men's and women's difficulties often exist in different dimensions. A closer look at Indian society, generation by generation — and why comparing them directly misses the point.

personal.title: What Intimacy Means to Me: Physical and Beyond Physical Touch
personal.excerpt: Intimacy has two sides — physical closeness and the connection that remains even when there is no physical closeness at all.

personal.title: What I Think About the Life of a Girl and Why
personal.excerpt: A girl's life depends on family, culture, geography, and safety. On village, city, and everything in between — and what genuine freedom should actually mean.

personal.title: What I Think About a Healthy Relationship and Why
personal.excerpt: Four pillars — mutual understanding, transparency, loyalty, and respect — applied across siblings, parents, friends, and couples.
